paragraphs.text:
You are in section-L. You go down the stairs until you come to 
a deep shaft. You dimly perceive that the passage continues on 
the other side of the shaft. 
• Do you want to leap across? Make a Jump roll: succeed, and 
go to 348; fail, and go to 369. 
• If you have a rope and use it to lower yourself down the shaft, 
go to 351. 
• If you don’t have a rope, you can try to jump down the shaft; 
make a Jump roll and note if you passed or failed the roll, and 
then go to 369. 
• Or you can return to 307.
(158, 307, 351, 395)
